record.question:
Rewrite the following sentences as directed
(a) Someone is knocking on the door. (to passive voice)
(b) Inspite of old age, he can run fast. (to compound)
(c) Go wherever your leader goes. (to simple)
(d) Is the baby loved by you? (to active voice)
(e) He said to me that he lived in Aizawl for five year. (to direct speech)
(f) The old man said, “Alas! I am undone.” (to indirect speech)
(g) He died in his native village. (to complex)
(h) He will do it. (to passive voice)
(i) The match can be won by our team. (to active voice)
(j) The queen said to the maid, “Bring my Crown.” (to indirect speech) (10×1=10)
